title: Verify that the hero renders the eyebrow, page title and description with the verified English design tokens
description: Page QCTEST-130949-ProposalForResearch is Published, EN locale, Light theme, 1920px. Tokens from Figma frame 2824:38277.
steps_list: Open a logged-out Chrome window sized 1920x1080 with the site theme set to Light and navigate to /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research
Inspect the hero eyebrow, title and description text and their computed styles
expected_list: The page loads LTR with no console error and no horizontal scrollbar; the hero block uses padding 40px 300px 0px over the gradient fill linear-gradient(118deg,#46071E 0%,#601430 48%,#911731 100%)

The eyebrow reads 'Economic Research Service' in Cairo 400 12px/18px #FFFFFF at 50% opacity, left-aligned; the title reads 'Proposal for Research' in Cairo 700 48px/60px #FFFFFF; the description reads 'Propose an economic or business-related research topic for consideration by Qatar Chamber's Research & Studies Department and access supporting templates and guidance.' in Cairo 400 16px/24px #FFFFFF at 70% opacity

Read the sticky index entries and inspect their computed styles and the rail container
Scroll until the Service information section reaches the top of the viewport and re-read the index
expected_list: The sticky index renders in a 312px rail to the left of the 944px content column, on a #F6F6F6 card with a 1px #EDEDED stroke and 8px radius

Exactly three entries render: '01 Overview', '02 Service information', '03 Downloadable resources'; each numeral is Cairo 700 14px/22px #A8A8A7 and each label is Cairo 600 14px/22px #6C6C6B; no entry reading 'Frequently asked questions' and no duplicate 'Overview' entry is present
The rail stays pinned while the page scrolls and the '02 Service information' entry is visually marked as the active entry
